feeds.title: Black Girls Run Blog
feeds.description: Black Girl Run encourages and motivates African-American women to practice a healthy lifestyle and serves as a resource for all fitness levels. Their goal is to start a movement to encourage ALL women to get off the couch and get active. Their blog helps you to feel motivated as they share amazing stories, and give updates about events, healthy eating tips, and similar topics.

feeds.title: Black Southern Belle
feeds.description: Black Southern Belle is a lifestyle media brand for all things 'Southern Bred and Soul Infused.' & focuses on Black American women in and from the South. On their website, they cover topics like home decor and fashion, love and dating, travel, career and finance, food and drinks, and more.

feeds.title: Black Women's Health Imperative Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest from the Black Women's Health Imperative Blog. Changing black women's lives through advocacy and public policy, health education, research and leadership development, the Black Women's Imperative works to advance health equity and social justice for Black women across the lifespan.

feeds.title: Black Girl Nerds
feeds.description: Black Girl Nerds is an online publication and multimedia space that is the intersection of geek culture and Black feminism. On their website, they have several contents like BGN exclusives, podcasts, and blog posts on art, culture, beauty, fashion, entertainment, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Sipofdetechlife
feeds.description: 'Sipofdetechlife' is a balancing act between my career in technology and lifestyle with findings I've learned along the way from professional, beauty, and fashion to cultural experiences. My goal is to inspire, share tips and cultivate a community of thinkers, doers, and dreamers!

feeds.title: My Local Adventures Blog
feeds.description: My Local Adventures follows the travels and experiences of Ngumabi, an ambitious African woman sharing her experience to inspire other ambitious African women to pursue their dreams and live fulfilling lives. Sharing lifestyle, personal development, fashion, beauty, and African recipes, for ambitious African women.

feeds.title: Black Women in Sport Blog
feeds.description: The Black Women in Sport Foundation was founded in 1992 by Tina Sloan Green, Alpha Alexander, Nikki Franke, and Linda Greene as a nonprofit organization dedicated to increasing the involvement of Black women and girls in all aspects of the sport. The blog covers news revolving around the involvement of black women in the world of sports. It not covers the latest news but also gives updates about events, programs, and donation activities.

feeds.title: Therapy for Black Girls Blog
feeds.description: The Therapy for Black Girls podcast is a weekly conversation with Dr. Joy Harden Bradford, a licensed psychologist in Atlanta, Georgia, about all things mental health, personal development, and all the small decisions we can make to become the best possible version of ourselves.

feeds.title: Black Girl Ventures Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2016 by Serial Entrepreneur and Computer Scientist Shelly Bell, The Black Girl Ventures Foundation (BGV) supports Black/Brown women in overcoming barriers to business growth. Their mission: provide access to community, capital, and capacity building, fostering economic advancement through entrepreneurship. Explore their blog covering mental health, financial empowerment, partnerships, and more for valuable insights.

feeds.title: MadameNoire
feeds.description: MadameNoire, a premier lifestyle website for Black women, debuted in 2010, offering daily doses of inspiration and news. Their mission is to empower women of colour with a wide-ranging content mix, spanning health, fashion, beauty, career, parenting, entertainment, and breaking news.

feeds.title: Essence » Fashion
feeds.description: Find out which are the best sunscreens for you according to your skin type and protect your skin the right way. ESSENCE.com: Your Voice. Your Style. Your Life. is an expansive web destination aimed to be the ultimate online destination for African-American women. ESSENCE.com serves as the daily source for African American-related news, entertainment and community, and reflects the intimate tone and approach of the esteemed ESSENCE brand.

feeds.title: Urban Belle Magazine
feeds.description: Urban Belle is quickly becoming one of the fastest growing sites for black celebrities, black celebrity news, urban gossip, and the rawest source for what's hot in today's black culture. Praised for its straight up and no chaser content, there is simply no other online magazine for black women on the internet this dope.

feeds.title: HelloBeautiful
feeds.description: HelloBeautiful.com is where Black women go to talk about themselves shamelessly. We share, confess, indulge, encourage and celebrate each other while indulging our guilty pleasures. HelloBeautiful embraces the diversity of today's Black woman and allows her to be perfectly flawed and fabulous. On their website, they publish articles on various topics like hair, style, fashion, the latest news, and beauty.

feeds.title: The Frugal Feminista Blog
feeds.description: This blog covers articles about personal finance, lifestyle, and all things financial empowerment, girl power & juicy living. The website is handled by Kara who helps women heal their relationship with money so they can play BIG with it- save with soul, demolish debt, retire in abundance, invest with ease, and scale their wealth without deprivation.

feeds.title: xoNecole
feeds.description: Necole Kane's online destination, xoNecole.com, is a newly defined platform for young women to share their personal stories, indulge in career, beauty, and relationship tips, and speak their minds on the latest in culture news and politics.

feeds.title: Lady Marielle
feeds.description: Family & lifestyle blog about a Haitian-Canadian mom with a passion for food, shopping, and blogging. Join me for delicious recipes, reviews, and blogging tips.

feeds.title: Made by Carli
feeds.description: Made by Carli was started in 2010 when blogging was fairly new. On this webpage, Carli shares budget home decor and DIY ideas. On this page, you will find small home projects, home decor, do-it-yourself guides and plans, and much more interesting information to make your home more beautiful.

feeds.title: Black Girls Eat
feeds.description: Plant-based advocate LA Dunn shares recipes and more to encourage women and families to make healthier food choices. Her website also features shopping ideas and advice that will lead you to a better and healthier lifestyle.

feeds.title: One Girl One World
feeds.description: I'm a California girl who's got an incurable case of the travel bug! One Girl: One World is a travel blog that's taking you around the world and back! My mission is to inspire people from all walks of life to get out there and experience all the world has to offer! I encourage you to talk to strangers, learn new languages, try new foods and dance to a different beat!

feeds.title: Simply Sasha Fierce Blog
feeds.description: Simply Sasha Fierce Blog is all about fashion, clothing, beauty, lifestyle and travel. Sasha started this as a fashion blog but soon decided to add more valuable content to her site. Her blog is known to give fashion and style-related tips while being on a budget.

feeds.title: Mattie James Blog
feeds.description: Mattie James, a renowned lifestyle influencer and entrepreneur, offers insights into her daily life and passions on her blog. From family and decor to travel and recipes, she provides diverse content. Follow her for fashion, shopping advice, beauty reviews, and a plethora of lifestyle tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Seriously Natural
feeds.description: Seriously Natural is all about Natural hair, beauty and style. From the basics to not-so-known tidbits; Seriously Natural blog brings all women the necessities to feel as lovely as they should with proper knowledge, tips and secrets that the experts know.

feeds.title: La Passion Voûtée
feeds.description: La Passion Voutee is not just an online journal; it is a cross-sectional platform for Louisa who wants to share her passion for fashion, beauty, and lifestyle. She enjoys shopping (which the girl doesn't), cooking, traveling, playing dress up and sharing everything she knows about Alaska, fashion, and beauty, starting and growing a fashion blog.

feeds.title: Shalyce Tyson Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Shalyce Tyson's blog, a haven of inspiration and relatability. Delve into her glow-getter lifestyle, where she shares personal anecdotes, tips, and recommendations. From motherhood to style, beauty, business, and family fun, explore a myriad of topics curated just for you. Feel free to suggest topics for her to cover and join the journey of connection with other amazing women.

feeds.title: Thrifts + Tangles Blog
feeds.description: Tyler Chanel is the creator behind Thrifts & Tangles. Thrifts and Tangles began in 2012 as a way for Tyler to document her natural hair journey. After receiving several questions about her secondhand clothing from friends and family, she expanded into sharing thrifted fashion. Follow her blog, which provides educational tips and resources to encourage millennial women to give thrifting, sustainability, and their natural selves a chance.

feeds.title: The Black Girl Doctor Blog
feeds.description: The Black Girl Doctor Blog is a virtual therapy practice specializing in the mental health and wellness of professional Black women. We offer therapy, online and in-person courses, and corporate wellness services! Discussing all things wellness for professional Black women​ who seek moremoney, more love, and more happiness.

feeds.title: Black Girl in Maine Blog
feeds.description: Since 2008, Black Girl in Maine has been a place for articles and stories on societal, cultural, educational, and even inspirational topics. The blog page is a digital space for in-depth discussions on racism and white supremacy, a podcast series, and public talks.

feeds.title: Outdoorsy Black Women Blog
feeds.description: Outdoorsy Black Women is a social network/community for Black Women that allows us to connect, celebrate and open our minds to an outdoorsy lifestyle.

feeds.title: So She Writes by Miss Dre Blog
feeds.description: beauty/lifestyle blog: beauty product reviews | fashion/personal style inspiration | self-improvement | parenting + married life

feeds.title: Black Women in Science Network Blog
feeds.description: Black Women in Science serves as a beacon of support and empowerment for black women scientists navigating the complexities of their careers. This online networking platform and blog, authored by black women in science, amplifies their voices and experiences while championing diversity, equality, and inclusion in the scientific realm. With a dedicated focus on fostering community and advancing professional growth, it cultivates a vibrant space where talent thrives and barriers are dismantled, shaping the future of science for generations to come.

feeds.title: Black Women's Studies Association Blog
feeds.description: The Black Women's Studies Association is a professional organization dedicated to scholars engaged in research about Black women. BWSA is an inclusive, anti-oppressive space that welcomes scholarly contributions about Black trans women, non-binary people, queer women, and cis-gendered women.

feeds.title: Black Women for Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Advancing the health and well-being of Black women and girls through education, empowerment and advocacy.

feeds.title: Rosetta Thurman Blog
feeds.description: Rosetta Thurman is the Founder of Happy Black Woman and a life and business coach for Black women who want it all.On her website, she wrote articles on helpful topics such as let's normalize working less & living more, the destructive cycle of playing small and you must define success for yourself.

feeds.title: Oneika the Traveller Blog
feeds.description: This is a travel and lifestyle blog penned by a Jamaican-Canadian who has been to nearly 100 countries. Toronto-born but New York City-based, she is obsessed with experiencing everything this gorgeous planet has to offer. This travel blog is dedicated to inspiring, encouraging, and empowering women and people of color to see the world.

feeds.title: Black Women Build Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2017 by Shelley Halstead, Black Women Build - Baltimore is a home ownership and wealth-building initiative that trains black women in carpentry, electrical, and plumbing by rehabilitating vacant and deteriorated houses in West Baltimore. Follow their news blog page to get all the latest updates from the organization, their projects, and their team.

feeds.title: Black Girl Lost Keys Blog
feeds.description: Rene Brooks after being diagnosed with ADHD 3 times, at 25 was able to get the treatment she deserved. She is the founder of Black Girl, Lost Keys, a blog that empowers black women with ADHD and shows them how to live well with the disorder. The blog covers topics like Aromatherapy, Things You Need Post ADHD Diagnosis and her podcast episodes

feeds.title: Black Girl Digital Blog
feeds.description: The BLACK GIRL DIGITAL blog covers consumer-driven content on the black female audience, as well as custom and curated content on digital marketing and influencer marketing. Follow their website blog if you want to read about the listing of various genres, black women podcasts, health-related tips, holiday guides, influencer marketing campaigns, and similar informative articles.

feeds.title: Influencing In Color
feeds.description: IIC (Influencing In Color) seeks to enlighten our community and provide a positive influence for people of all colors through advocacy, collaboration, and commitment to diversity & inclusivity. The four woman's group aims to inspire, educate, encourage social change, and pursue shared goals through collaborative partnerships. Their blog page consists of articles on fashion, lifestyle, travel, career, beauty and relationships.

feeds.title: simplycyn
feeds.description: simplycyn is blog page run by Cynthia from NYC. In this blog she shares about all the things he loves in her life. He blog feed consists of travel articles, reviews, fashion tips, food, music and many more.

feeds.title: Life with Tanay
feeds.description: Life with Tanay, born as a hobby in 2014, has blossomed into a comprehensive family lifestyle site. From family travel to entertainment recommendations, they offer diverse content to simplify and enrich family life. With a commitment to well-rounded information, they aim to be your one-stop destination for all things lifestyle, motherhood, self-care, and beyond.

feeds.title: Buy from a Black Woman Blog
feeds.description: Because, we need to invest in each other.

feeds.title: The Conversation » Black Women
feeds.description: The Conversation is a nonprofit, independent news organization dedicated to unlocking the knowledge of experts for the public good. They publish trustworthy and informative articles written by academic experts for the public and edited by our team of journalists. They feature articles on black women that cover topics like racism, discrimination, problems faced, latest news and updates, anti-black narratives and more.

feeds.title: Melan Magazine
feeds.description: Since its inception in 2017, Melan Magazine has emerged as a beacon of empowerment and style for smart and stylish Black women. Its online platform curates a tapestry of captivating content, spanning women's fashion, health, relationships, trending news, and literature. Designed to be the online confidante for women of colour in the UK, Melan Magazine celebrates the multifaceted identities and experiences of its readers, fostering connection, inspiration, and empowerment with every click.

feeds.title: Curly Nikki
feeds.description: Find best information for natural hair care, curly hair care, and natural hair styles at Curly Nikki. Visit the website and read our blogs. Nikki Walton is a best-selling and NAACP Image Award-nominated author, TV personality, podcast host, and licensed psychotherapist. In 2008, Walton launched CurlyNikki.com, which became the number 1 natural hair care/beauty blog in the world, with the best articles on caring for natural hair.

feeds.title: Super.Selected.
feeds.description: Super Selected is an online fashion magazine featuring black fashion models, black fashion designers and black writers and artists. SUPER.selected is Black Art, Black Fashion, Life, Black Culture, Sanity, Black Fashion Models, Black Artists, Black Film, Black Celebrity News.

feeds.title: rss2
feeds.description: Black Women Talk Tech is an organization that aims to identify, support and encourage black women to build the next billion-dollar business. They are the largest collective of Black women tech founders with a unique understanding of the challenges black women face and the advantages they bring in the industry. The organization is building community and profitable, scalable businesses for self-identified Black women in tech. Thier press blog shares information about the latest updates of the organization and some informative articles for their readers.

feeds.title: Sober Black Girls Club
feeds.description: Sober Black Girls Club - a collective that provides love, support, and resources to Black girls, women, femmes, and nonconforming folks living or considering beautiful sober lives. On their website, they talk about topics like addiction, alcohol-free, BIPOC, black girl magic, black girls rock, black mental health, community, mental health, mocktails, recovery, and sober back girls.

feeds.title: Balanced Black Girl Blog
feeds.description: Balanced Black Girl is here to build a mindful collective that puts the needs of Black women first. They do this by creating free and accessible wellness content and resources, amplifying the voices of Black and brown women in wellness, and shining a light on healers and practitioners making waves in our community. Read interesting articles on their blog such as daily habits for a better life, podcast to hear, affirmation to hear, setting boundaries, and more,

feeds.title: The Budgetnista Blog
feeds.description: Tiffany 'The Budgetnista' Aliche, is an award-winning teacher of financial education, America's favorite, personal financial educator, and author of the New York Times Bestselling book. Follow her blog to learn about tips and tricks to save money in a really effective and consistent way. She also gives us in-depth knowledge about the world of finance and money.
